verdict.rationale: Notion's database functionality (referenced generally in notion-comm-1/comm-4) natively supports task-like items with assignable Person and Date properties, and the REST API (notion-docs-1) allows programmatic creation/updates of pages/database items, which underlies task assignment workflows. However, no direct evidence describes native due-date/assignee UI fields, notification-on-assignment, or task-tracking features explicitly; community notes (notion-comm-6, notion-comm-12) indicate task/project-tracking use hits limits requiring manual maintenance and notifications are unreliable. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of assignee/due-date properties, task notification reliability evidence, and independent confirmation of smooth assignment workflows.
